extName.description: Extension name shown in the manifest and store

extDesc.message: Open any URL — or a clean dashboard with your top sites and bookmarks — in every new tab. Modern, fast, no tracking.
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in the manifest and store

redirectDesc.message: Enter the address to open in every new tab. Leave it empty to show the default dashboard.

urlPlaceholder.message: example.com or https://… — empty shows the dashboard

urlEmpty.message: Empty — the default dashboard will be shown

urlInvalid.message: This is not a valid address

urlUnsupported.message: This address type is not supported

urlLoop.message: This address would reopen the new tab page — not allowed

fileAccessNote.message: To open local file:// pages, also enable “Allow access to file URLs” for this extension on chrome://extensions.

modeNavigateHint.message: Replaces the new tab in place — no extra entry in history.

modeTabUpdateHint.message: The cursor stays in the address bar after opening, ready to type a search.

syncHint.message: Uses your Chrome profile sync. Only this extension's settings are synced — never your browsing data.

dashboardDesc.message: Shown when no redirect URL is set.

permMissing.message: Permission will be requested when you turn this on

permDeniedHint.message: Permission was denied. Turn it off and on again to request it once more.

resetDesc.message: Clears your redirect URL and dashboard preferences on this device.

resetConfirmDesc.message: Your redirect URL and dashboard preferences will be cleared. This cannot be undone.

welcomeSubtitle.message: New Tab Redirect opens any address — or a clean dashboard — in every new tab.

welcomePrivacy.message: Open source (MIT). No tracking, no remote code, no data collection. Settings stay on your device or in your Chrome Sync.

welcomeAttribution.message: Based on New Tab Redirect! by James Schubert, licensed under the MIT license.

dashTopSitesEmpty.message: No top sites yet — browse a little and they will appear here.

dashPermDeniedBookmarks.message: Permission denied — enable it in settings

dashPermDeniedTopSites.message: Permission denied — enable it in settings

dashRedirectFailed.message: Redirect failed — check the address in settings

footerAttribution.message: Based on New Tab Redirect! by James Schubert (MIT).
